scope: Prospective interpretation of v16 person-source binding and separate first-birthplace/geography admission; no network or source-body verification, no master mutation.
decision: Admissible as an explicitly documented v16 method amendment, subject to record-level gates; no permanent date or identity correction and no statistical inference.

distinction_from_v15.v15_observed_rule: v15 protocol explicitly required unique full-name plus exact-date binding; all five accepted v15 sources met that batch condition.
distinction_from_v15.v16_proposal: v16 plan permits compatible partial source dates plus distinguishing anchors. A source with no birth date at all requires a separate explicit no-source-DOB category; it must not be reported as an exact or partial DOB match.
distinction_from_v15.status: This is a v16 collection/admission interpretation, not an immutable rule recovered from v15 and not a source-blind preregistration. Preserve v15 unchanged and record amendment timing truthfully before final v16 acceptance.

admission_gates.requirement: Target is one of the fixed 12 followups and one of the 164 frozen v15 blank-birthplace window records; native record key is fixed.
Read an original available biography/obituary body or public original extract. A discovery snippet, bibliography, inaccessible source, or search title cannot supply the adopted birth clause.

Explicit full native authority name, allowing only documented harmless orthographic normalization, plus multiple distinctive concordant lifespan/membership/career anchors. Do not expand initials or change the native identity. Check the frozen UK pool for candidate ambiguity.

Record source_birthdate_precision truthfully. Exact-date, year-only, month/year, age-at-death-only, and no-DOB are distinct. Compare what is actually stated for compatibility; do not infer or store a new native birthday or claim its independent verification.

For no-DOB or age-only cases, full-name agreement alone is insufficient. Require at least two distinctive, substantively different concordant anchors such as FRS election year and a specific multi-institution career sequence, plus compatible lifespan/age where available. Multiple facts from one article remain one source, not independent corroborating sources. Hold unresolved alternative-person or explicit date conflicts.

An explicit born-in/at or equivalently unambiguous subject-birthplace assertion is required. Residence, family roots, childhood, schooling, employment, nationality, death or funeral place do not substitute.
Retain the actual born-clause place wording. A first stored birthplace may be accepted while hemisphere stays unknown; count these as birthplace additions but not geographic resolutions.

Under the current strict workflow, hemisphere adoption requires explicit birth-linked country/region resolving wholly to one hemisphere. No inference from the familiar city, newspaper region, parents, childhood, employer, national identity or footer.

Grade new birthplace support separately from frozen native DOB tiers. Authorship, original publication role and visible editorial provenance determine grade; an official host or professional hosting alone is not S1/S2 proof.

Modify only allowed current birthplace/geography fields; retain full prior-field and prior-absent-field snapshots. Leave native DOB, calendar, authority identity, eligibility, QID, country, coordinates, DOB source tiers, original selected evidence/status/hashes and all untargeted complete objects unchanged.

Raftery_candidate_assessment.material_limit: Assessment is conditional on parent-reported observations, not a direct reading of the Mayo News body.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.reported_subject: Michael Augustine Raftery; death in 2007 aged71; FRS1986; Caltech23years and Minnesota career; explicit born-in Galway.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.identity: This combination can justify a uniquely bound first-birthplace candidate even without a birth date, if full name and anchors are actually present in the source body, no competing frozen record or contradictory date is observed, and parent separately verifies the body.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.source_DOB_status: No stated source birth date; record null birthdate and precision no_DOB_age_at_death_only. Native1936-02-08 is preserved, not independently verified or reconstructed from age.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.birthplace: Galway may be stored literally from the direct birth clause if verified.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.hemisphere: Keep unknown from the reported evidence. Co Mayo describing parents or growing up does not qualify Galway as the birth country/region. Do not assign Ireland, a unique Galway entity or coordinates.
Raftery_candidate_assessment.grade: Conservative S3 pending visible authorship/editorial-provenance review. An uncredited newspaper life notice should not receive S2 merely because it is professionally published. S2 could be considered only with documented original authored/edited biographical provenance; otherwise retain S3 and caveats.

counting_and_claims: 164 is the remaining blank-field pool; 12 is the actual fixed original-source followup scope. Do not claim 164 original biographies read.
First birthplace additions, newly resolved hemisphere records and additions whose geography remains unknown must be counted separately.
New S2/S3 birthplace support does not alter the existing DOB-based S2 versus S2+S3 analysis groups.
No revised statistical hypothesis, selection-weight inference, outcome analysis, cross-cohort statistical deduplication or final freeze follows from this collection step.
blocking_conditions_for_individual_accep: Explicit incompatible source date or identity anchor
Geographic assignment based solely on an unqualified familiar place or non-birth association
Claiming exact DOB verification from age/year/no-DOB evidence
